🫏 New post ready 💬 One-liner · parents · 🎬 Reel, 9.6s, wistful tune “three hundred miles apart, but we still send the storm radar twenty minutes before the rain hits either house.” ✍️ Caption
we were never built for long phone calls on a tuesday. he just watches the yellow clouds moving toward my town, and i track his. send this to your dad if he still texts you to roll the windows up when the wind picks up. #dad #dadquotes #fatherdaughter #fatherson
